**Command**
```bash
zerodom audit <path> --url <url>
```

**Summary line** (the last line of the report)
```
ambiguous N · dead N · invalid N · ok N
```

**Was it right?**
- [ ] Yes — these are real problems in our suite
- [ ] Partly — some were real, some were noise
- [ ] No — false positives
